description: Epic 119's capability/cost routing table. Each task picks from the models below: those with at least its min_capability, cheapest first ('cheapest') or most capable first ('best'). The models are config.py's env-driven specs; a model whose key or host is not set is skipped at call time.

local.notes: Ollama on OLLAMA_HOST: free, offline, small

fallback.notes: Gemini Flash, low reasoning, on GEMINI_API_KEY's free tier

narration.description: Short lines that describe what just happened: commentary filler, captions, recaps.

summary.description: Condense a drive or a game into a few sentences from structured data.

analysis.description: Read game state and explain it: key plays, tendencies, matchups.

strategy.description: Decide: a play-call consultation from the situation and tendencies.

delegate.description: A bridge task handed off to a free-tier model (Core 25).
